title: A Static for the Orbit
author: Ada Iversen
blurb: Rafael Eriksen, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the fleet's truce expires.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
